'''Joha Marik''' was a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] working aboard the ''[[Free Lance]]'' under [[Urias Xhaxin]]. However, he disagreed with Xhaxin's affiliation with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was expelled from the crew, captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] security forces as a result. He was sentenced to immediate [[Death/Legends|execution]].
